dartSetup: Target Crypton 25 grams, Cosmo #5 stems and cosmo fit flights shape.
checkouts: Yes performed checkouts. Double 16 and double 8 are favs.
achievements: Making darts Nova Scotia for many many years!
aadsMeaning: Was very pleased to be invited.

dartSetup: 21gram GOAT Sprocket darts, straight barrel, points about 30mm or less, three winged Condors. I bounce back and forth between the three winged flights and normal flights.
practiceRoutine: Right now it's almost every day at least 20mins or longer. I shoot mainly at doubles till I hit every one a few times then sometimes I'll do a game or two, or I'll just pick random common out shots and practice those a bit.
strengths: Usually I can score pretty consistently. I'm a 20 shooter but can hit what I aim for. The 32 and 40 breakdowns are pretty comfortable for me.
improvements: My set-up play lacks sometimes. Always working on doubles and finishing.
checkouts: The 40 break down route and the 32 are probably my best friends. I had a 148 out in Bedford in November in ladies doubles, had a 157 in one of my league playoff nights.
currentForm: I'm pretty happy with my darts right now. Been practicing more and there's been loads of good darts thrown. Always room for improvement but I feel good right now.
recentResults: Made a couple last 32/16s in shediac in mixed and ladies doubles. Won the triples and ladies doubles events in Bedford. Made joint third in the singles at Red Rock and again in Bedford.
achievements: Winning in Bedford twice is probably my favorite achievement so far. Have a few joint thirds in singles events. Had to beat some top talent to get there. Won a couple fundraiser tournaments around home.
pressureManagement: I try to focus on myself, not looking at what people are shooting. Just thinking to myself this is what I need right now, go get it. Keeping things positive is important for me.
mentalApproach: When I step up I'm focused on my target immediately.
stagePresence: Never been on stage so I wouldn't know haha. I think sometimes I can be expressive but I'd like to think I'm pretty stoic.
preMatchRituals: I don't think so, just give myself a warm up on the boards before I play.
aadsMeaning: It's always nice to be invited to events and to be considered good enough to compete with people who've been playing darts for years. Being a part of the series is another highlight of my very short darting career.

dartSetup: One80 Emily Alford Player Signature Darts. Lstyle Carbon Shafts and Lstyle Fantom Flights.
practiceRoutine: I play in several leagues throughout the week. When playing by myself I play a lot of 121 to keep my arm going and to continue to challenge myself in finding better checkout routes.
strengths: I can adjust my game very easily to adapt to the style of others. Sometimes this helps when I'm playing people who don't match my playing style.
improvements: Trying to develop my mindset and better focus when playing matches.
checkouts: I like to leave anything around the 16s but certainly don't shy away from tops either. I also like to use the bull quite a bit when setting myself up and checking out.
currentForm: Trying to continue momentum I've had over the last couple months.
recentResults: 2nd in the Halifax Open. 1st in the Debbie Mullin Memorial Open (Debbie was a huge support of me as a youth player). Made Team Nova Scotia for the NDFC Nationals placing 4th in the province.
achievements: Representing Canada at the 2018/2019 BDO World Masters (Top 8 in 2019). Representing Canada at the WDF World Cup in Cluj Napoca Romania. Representing Canada at the 2021 JDC World Cup in Gibraltar. 2019 Junior Girls Canadian Champion. 2 sportsmanship awards in 2016 and 2019.
pressureManagement: I try to focus on something else rather than the game itself. If I focus too much on mechanics I lose focus. I also tend to look at my loved ones to ground myself.
mentalApproach: Very Happy Go Lucky but Focused.
stagePresence: I tend to keep focused. Normally drink something when I come back from the line. I look out to loved ones if I get nervous to ground myself.
preMatchRituals: None really. Just something I never really developed.
aadsMeaning: I am very honored and excited to have been invited to this event. I have so much respect for all the ladies in this event and it is really cool having us all together for this.

checkouts: Confidence is key, on the day my main focus is practicing doubles.
currentForm: Managed a win at the red rock open. Currently ranked 5th in Canada.
recentResults: Winning the Canadian championship in 2018. Canada's MVP 2019. 2 time world master qualifier in England. America Cup qualifier in Trinidad and Tobago. 2 time World Cup qualifier in Romania and Amsterdam. 3 time New Brunswick champion. 2 time Canadian double champion with Joanne Luke.
achievements: It's just me and the board.
pressureManagement: Depends on the day, if my confidence is up my head's down and ready to go.
mentalApproach: I would say I'm focused most of the time.
stagePresence: Not really, except I do wear my lucky socks with the heel gone in them. Lol
preMatchRituals: To be honest, I'm more excited about this than the Canadian nationals. Great group of competitors, something different.

hobbies: I have a 5 month old grandson I love spending time with.
currentForm: Happy to be invited after struggling with my throw and doubling out for the past year.
achievements: I'm proud of the times I've been ranked 1st in my province.
aadsMeaning: A fantastic opportunity to play with some great opponents!

practiceRoutine: Playing games with different people with higher averages.
recentResults: Won the last few tournaments I've played - sadly not on DartConnect.
achievements: Taking a singles tournament at the Shediac legion.
pressureManagement: Staying calm, not talking on the line.
aadsMeaning: Beating some of the best around.

dartSetup: Harrows Power Points (hammer heads) 22g, Mission force 90 moulded flight and shaft medium. My first and only set of darts!
practiceRoutine: I practice my doubles starting from dbl 20 all the way down to the bull. I sometimes time myself. If I have more time I try to hit each double 5 times before moving to the next. Then I'll hit the main triples and play a game of 501 or 170.
strengths: If I can get in a good flow I can find myself shooting scores of 100+ back to back. I prefer leaving myself with dbl 16 or dbl 20.
improvements: My stance and the way I throw. Sometimes my arm is not locked in where it should be. Also my mindset on certain situations and figuring out my best option for a double out. Always learning!
checkouts: I try not to limit myself to only a specific double as it always changes for me. I finished a 154 at NB tryouts, and I'm still trying to get that 170 finish - it's my goal!
currentForm: I'm super excited for this event! I'm making sure I'm hitting the board and getting the rhythm of my throw to be at my best on May 30th!
recentResults: Won the Ladies Single NB Port City open last September. Lost against Darlene McCloud at the Nova Scotia open in November.
achievements: Previously made the NB team in 2003, 2004 and 2005. After 19 years away I returned to darts and won 1st place ladies single at Cocagne. Made NB team in 2024 (5th) and 2025 (4th). In 2026 clinched 1st place for team NB - my proudest achievement!
pressureManagement: I try to stay calm and focus on what I need to get done. Pretty much tell myself you got this, one dart at a time.
mentalApproach: Mostly calm and focused, but sometimes aggressive at the start of a leg to set the tone.
stagePresence: On stage I'm mostly focused on the board. I try to block out the crowd. Just me
aadsMeaning: I keep my arm warmed up before the game and stay mentally tough, reminding myself I'm a really good player and I can beat anyone.
dartConnectEmail: I'm super excited and I'm definitely gonna give it my all. The women playing at this event are all amazing dart players and this is all our time to shine!

hobbies: I coach high school volleyball, play women's volleyball and coed softball. Love hunting and fishing!
dartSetup: 23g Karrah Kennedy Princess darts with 41mm points, and caliburn tweeny flights. Recently made the switch to somewhat longer points.
practiceRoutine: No specific routine YET! Just beating Adam at the moment.
strengths: Lately, scoring for me has come a long way. A lot of studying numbers and learning the math really made my game step up. Knowing the board is HUGE.
improvements: I think everyone can always work on nailing those doubles. That's usually a big focus for me.
currentForm: Definitely finding my rhythm right now. Confidence is building!
recentResults: Not lately. It's gonna come though!!!
achievements: I'm super proud of competing with team NB in 2025, and getting to go again this year.
pressureManagement: Working on staying positive through the entire match. It's not over until that last double is hit, every single dart matters. I've been focusing more on my side of the scoreboard and not what my opponent is doing.
stagePresence: Trying to stay focused on the board more.
preMatchRituals: I have to find a specific spot on the oche for my foot. After each throw, trying to look down at my feet and not the opponent's throw or score.
aadsMeaning: I'm very excited and honoured to be chosen to compete in this event! We've followed a lot of the AADS men's events and I've been waiting for the day we get to join in on the action!

dartSetup: Phoenix Custom barrels 22g, 6.5mm dia, 50mm long with Cosmo Standard #3 Locked Shafts and Cosmo Fit Flight Air Standard Flights
practiceRoutine: Focusing on finishes starting at 121 and moving up. If I miss I move down a number, if I succeed I move up. I also have a deck of cards with finishes from 170 down - I flip a card and give myself 6 darts to complete it. I struggle to practice alone so solo practice is 15-30 minutes. With a friend I can shoot for hours.
strengths: Composure and clutch finishing. Friends have coined me as "3rd Dart Jo" for often hitting my required treble on my 3rd dart. I've learned to keep myself calm(er) in games which has benefitted me in the long run.
improvements: Setups from the 300+ scores. Knowing when to move around the board to set yourself up appropriately for the next 3 darts.
checkouts: A double is a double but I prefer a double that will break down (32/16/8/4/2/1). I am comfortable moving around the board and will take the route to the quickest finish.
currentForm: Very confident and pleased with my current performance. Aiming at building and improving focus and consistency.
recentResults: EAST COAST OPEN: 1st Place Mixed Doubles. 2nd Place Ladies Singles. 2nd Place Ladies Doubles with Ashley Foster. NS PROVINCIALS: 2nd Place. DEBBIE MULLIN MEMORIAL: Ladies Singles Joint 5th. 2025 World Masters in Budapest - nerves got the best of me but given the opportunity again I'll be ready!
achievements: 2025 Nova Scotia Provincial Champ. 2024 and 2025 World Masters Invitations. 170 checkout!
pressureManagement: BREATHE! Just Breathe! I talk to myself, sometimes out loud, other times in my head. I stare the double down and make it mine.
mentalApproach: Calm, cool and collected at the oche. Sometimes humming a tune to keep it fun and positive.
stagePresence: Mostly focused on the board but using key people as focal points. I throw my darts and after each throw concentrate on my hands or flights and think about my next shot.
preMatchRituals: I don't believe I have any specific rituals, and if I do I'm not aware of them!
aadsMeaning: To be chosen as one of the first 10 women to be part of this inaugural event is truly an honor and I am humbled at this opportunity! It's a clear indication that I'm headed in the right direction.
